global: {player} has a long winning streak now. Streaks end, and they usually end at the worst possible moment.
Another win for {player}. I remember when a run like this made the whole server nervous. It passed. It always does.
Nobody on this server is impressed by a streak yet. Ask me again after the next siege.
Lucky timing and a full purse can carry anyone through a few fights. Let's see who's still standing in a month.
I've watched three champions rise and fall here. Being on top is the quickest way to get a line of people hoping you trip.
Some of you are cheering {player} as if this were a new age of heroes. Wins come cheap when the other side is distracted.
Every streak I've seen was built on fights nobody else bothered to show up for. Remember that before crowning anyone.
I don't mind {player} winning. I mind how the winning gets talked about. Keep the boasting short.
whisper: Enjoying the streak, {player}? Enjoy it while the roads are quiet. They get busy fast once people start planning.
Your run of wins has caught the attention of people who don't forget. I'd watch your back for a while.
I won't congratulate you. Winning this often makes people careless, and careless people end up in my ledger.
Every streak ends in a loss. I'd rather yours ended somewhere other than in front of my banners.
You've been lucky with your timing, {player}. Luck is a poor thing to bet a whole fief on.
Pride looks good on the scoreboard. It looks less good when the supply wagons stop arriving.
Don't mistake a few wins for a reputation. Reputations take years to build and an afternoon to lose.
I'll keep my distance for now. When someone who wins this much finally picks a fight with me, I'll be ready.

global: {player} is on a real run now. Good. This server could use a fight that doesn't end in arguments.
Interesting stretch of wins from {player}. I'll wait and see how the next few weeks go before forming an opinion.
Many wins in a row draw attention. Attention brings envoys, scouts and the occasional bad idea. Plan for all three.
A streak like this belongs in the server ledgers, if nothing else. Keep your logs, folks.
Strong run, {player}. Remember that the people you beat today may be the ones writing letters tomorrow.
The map looks different after a run like that. Borders move, alliances shift, and everyone starts counting.
Credit where it's due, {player} has been winning steadily. Whether it lasts depends on what happens between battles.
Long streaks tend to bring out two kinds of people: those who want to learn from them and those who want to copy them.
whisper: Your recent run has people talking, {player}. Keep an eye on who talks the loudest.
Quite a streak. If you want advice from someone who has watched a few of these, keep your sword hand free for surprises.
I'm not sure yet whether you're a rising name or a passing one. Ask me again when the streak breaks.
Don't let the praise go to your head, and don't let the critics get under your skin. Both pass quickly.
Good numbers, {player}. Keep a written record of your battles. It helps when people start misremembering.
If anyone offers to fight beside you for a share of the glory, have them write down the terms first.
Winning this often means favors will be asked of you soon. Decide now which ones you'll refuse.
I wouldn't change how you fight just yet. I'd only change who you let flatter you.

global: {player} has been winning steadily and doing it cleanly. That's the kind of play newcomers should study.
Proud of how {player} has been fighting lately. Streaks are rare, and this one was earned in the open.
Seeing {player} string wins together reminds me why I still log in every evening. Keep it up, friend.
A few more of these and the younger players will start copying {player}'s formations. That's a fine legacy.
Nice run, {player}. The fiefs you took were defended by people who knew what they were doing, too.
Some streaks fade fast. This one looks sturdy. Good discipline on the field has a way of lasting.
Congratulations to {player} on the streak. Share your method with the newer folks when you get the chance.
If the server ever writes a history of its good fights, {player} will already have a whole chapter.
whisper: Take a day away from the field before the next fight, {player}. Even the best need to step back for a while.
Your last few battles have been a pleasure to watch, {player}. Thank you for fighting with such care.
Don't let the streak go to your head. Keep helping newcomers the way you have, and the wins will mean more.
I'm proud to have you on this server, {player}. Your streak is good for everyone who fights beside you.
If you'd like, I can share a few notes from the old campaigns that might help you keep this going.
Another strong set of battles, {player}. Come find me on a quiet evening. I have a story to share.
Your timing and temper have been excellent lately, {player}. Don't forget the quiet work that supports the wins.
Honestly, {player}, watching you this week has been a pleasure. Keep your head level and you'll be remembered well.
